en: In the morning, Arif stands in the yard. His shadow is long and thin. It stretches far across the grass.
At lunchtime, the sun is high above his head. Arif looks down. His shadow is short and small, right by his feet.
In the afternoon, Arif goes out again. His shadow is long again, but now it points the other way!
'Why does my shadow change?' asks Arif. Grandma smiles. 'Watch where the sun is each time.'
Arif sees it. When the sun is low, the shadow is long. When the sun is high, the shadow is short.
Arif draws round his shadow with chalk three times in one day. He has made a shadow clock!
id: Pagi hari, Arif berdiri di halaman. Bayangannya panjang dan ramping, terbentang jauh di atas rumput.
Saat makan siang, matahari tinggi di atas kepalanya. Arif melihat ke bawah. Bayangannya pendek dan kecil, tepat di dekat kakinya.
Sore hari, Arif keluar lagi. Bayangannya panjang lagi, tetapi sekarang menunjuk ke arah sebaliknya!
'Kenapa bayanganku berubah?' tanya Arif. Nenek tersenyum. 'Perhatikan di mana matahari setiap kali.'
Arif mengerti. Saat matahari rendah, bayangan panjang. Saat matahari tinggi, bayangan pendek.
Arif menggambar garis bayangannya dengan kapur tiga kali dalam sehari. Ia sudah membuat jam bayangan!

objectives.en: Reads a story and explains the cause of a change.
objectives.id: Membaca cerita dan menjelaskan penyebab sebuah perubahan.

objectives.en: Connects the length of a shadow to the position of the sun.
objectives.id: Menghubungkan panjang bayangan dengan posisi matahari.

meaning.en: a dark shape made when something blocks light
meaning.id: bentuk gelap yang terjadi saat sesuatu menghalangi cahaya

prompt.en: What was Arif's shadow like at lunchtime?
prompt.id: Seperti apa bayangan Arif saat makan siang?

prompt.en: When the sun is low in the sky, a shadow is…
prompt.id: Saat matahari rendah di langit, bayangan menjadi…

prompt.en: Why did the afternoon shadow point the other way?
prompt.id: Mengapa bayangan sore menunjuk ke arah sebaliknya?

en: the sun had moved to the other side of the sky
id: matahari sudah pindah ke sisi langit yang lain

prompt.en: Which shadow did Arif see second in the day?
prompt.id: Bayangan mana yang dilihat Arif kedua kalinya dalam sehari?

connection.en: The sun seems to move across the sky during the day, so shadows change length and direction.
connection.id: Matahari tampak bergerak melintasi langit sepanjang hari, sehingga panjang dan arah bayangan berubah.

discussionPrompts.en: Can you make your shadow look like an animal?
discussionPrompts.id: Bisakah kamu membuat bayanganmu seperti hewan?

discussionPrompts.en: Where would your shadow be at lunchtime tomorrow?
discussionPrompts.id: Di mana bayanganmu saat makan siang besok?

offlineActivity.en: Stand on the same spot at three times of day. An adult traces round the shadow with chalk each time and writes the time beside it.
offlineActivity.id: Berdiri di tempat yang sama pada tiga waktu berbeda. Orang dewasa menggambar garis bayangan dengan kapur setiap kali dan menulis jamnya.

factChecks.claim: Shadows are longest when the sun is low and shortest when it is high.

safetyNotes.en: Never look straight at the sun.
safetyNotes.id: Jangan pernah menatap matahari secara langsung.

safetyNotes.en: At midday, wear a hat, drink water and keep the tracing quick.
safetyNotes.id: Saat tengah hari, pakai topi, minum air, dan menggambarnya cepat saja.
